criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 1, 3, 5 and 8 pass most of the showstopper test: one wafer subject fills a third to two thirds of the frame on a near black bench with cast shadows. Frames 2, 6, 7 and 9 put their type on a flat black band that ends in a hard horizontal seam above the relief, which the 4 descriptor names as type on plates. Frames 2 and 7 sit in the grey middle and read as embossed drawings, not lit objects.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: The one wafer per $1 million scale is a real spine: 12 wafers on frame 3, 12 plus 12 on 4, 4.5 on 5, 12/4.5/19 on 6 and 19 empty sockets on 9. Frames 2 and 7 step outside that object world, and the camera switches between a raking 3D view and a flat plan relief with no declared cut.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every slide numeral traces to claims c1 to c19, each quoted from a fetched ttu.edu page, and frame 6 calls 19 a floor and draws no total. The governance facts on frame 2 come from a university press release, and 'not built yet' (c4) is inferred from 'will help establish'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, where, who and the missing date are all named. A reader gets no next step or deadline.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover's open ended boat earns the swipe, frame 6 is the turn, and the close's empty IN SERVICE recess pays off the 19 wafers. Frame 4 could fold into frame 3.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, sourced and on register. 'Drawn to illustrate' closes six of the nine bodies and reads as compliance boilerplate.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: An interior, floodlit, small object bench deck with no horizon, set apart from nos. 74 to 76, and the wafer as unit of money is a fresh move.

one_sentence_fix: Remove the flat black type bands and the hard seam under them on frames 2, 6, 7 and 9, and light each relief as a pool that falls off into true black at the top.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat copper crystal cutouts on mid grey textured slate below a hard black type band; no wafer scale.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rebuild it as a 3D close up of one wafer from the frame 1 bench, with a raised epitaxial island grown on its mirror face, raked by a single side light.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A stucco textured square in a grid of identical mid brown tiles under a hard seam, with black label type printed on the copper.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the surrounding county tiles to near black, raise only the Lubbock tile with a strong side light, and let the vignette carry up into the headline area.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The plate ends at a hard seam, the footer sits over the lower rivets, and the nineteen empty pockets read as vent holes at 432 px.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop the plate so its bottom rivets clear the footer, give the pockets a lit rim and visible floor, and fade the plate's top edge into the black field.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat graphic band under a seam; the discs are uniform grey buttons.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tilt the camera about 20 degrees off plan and rake the light low from the left so each disc shows a lit edge and a cast shadow.
